Latin word

nīl

nīl (nihil) moror

pronoun, indeclinable

I don’t care for, I can do without; nothing (the contracted form)

In this lexicon

  • care

    also used · classical · Hor. Ep. 1.15.16 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 94: nīl moror (+ acc.); Traupman 99

  • nothing

    also used · classical · Hor. S. 1.9.19: nīl habeō quod agam; Plaut. Trin. 4.2.134: nīl agis (Lewis & Short)

  • Dē mortuīs nīl nisi bonum.: speak no ill of the dead

    modern

Examples

  • nīl habeō quod agam et nōn sum piger: ūsque sequar tē

    I’ve nothing to do and I’m not lazy: I’ll follow you all the wayHor. S. 1.9.19
